QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Lunar New Year Video Message Project
QuestInfo.0: Yoria and Suha are anxious to tell you something important.
QuestInfo.1: Yoria is running a Lunar New Year Video Message Project. She's helping deliver messages between officers and their families while they aid in Maple World's restoration! See what you can do to help!
